detail: His 2022 declaration on taking up his Saeima seat listed two properties in Riga (LETA, 2022). According to LETA's reading of his declaration for 2025, at the end of 2025 he owned one property in Riga and was co-owner of another; TV3 likewise reports two properties in Riga. The reports give no type, size or value. Latvian public officials file declarations with the State Revenue Service (VID); the VID website gave no answer to the harvest on 23 October 2026, so this rests on press reports citing the declaration.
